title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (Part 2) (B)

questions.stem: A marathon runner mainly uses aerobic respiration, while a 100m sprinter relies more on anaerobic. Why is this?

options.text: Sprinters do not use glucose as a fuel
Marathon runners do not produce lactic acid
Marathon running is low intensity so oxygen supply can meet demand; sprinting is too intense for aerobic alone
Sprinters have more mitochondria than marathon runners

questions.explanation: Marathon running is sustained, moderate-intensity exercise where oxygen can be delivered fast enough. Sprinting is so intense that oxygen cannot be supplied quickly enough, so muscles rely heavily on anaerobic respiration.
